policy: Expected answers are transcribed/paraphrased from the PDF solution section. Cases are not marked executable unless the current structured UI/Brain can represent the decisive evidence without inventing facts.

cases.title: Package A/C callback after transformer replacement
cases.expected_answer: Transformer primary was connected to contactor T1/T2 instead of L1/L2; move primary supply to L1/L2.
cases.coverage_reason: Requires transformer primary/secondary wiring-point evidence not presently represented.

cases.title: Cooling but indoor blower stopped
cases.expected_answer: Thermostat sub-base AUTO contacts are not carrying current; replace the thermostat sub-base.
cases.coverage_reason: Requires thermostat sub-base AUTO-contact evidence not presently represented.

cases.title: A/C cycles on low pressure
cases.expected_answer: System is short of refrigerant; locate/repair leak, replace filter drier, evacuate and recharge.
cases.coverage_reason: Reusable refrigeration/low-charge diagnostic pattern.

cases.title: Reach-in freezer erratic temperature during hot-gas defrost
cases.expected_answer: Defrost timer NC contacts fail to open, allowing evaporator fan to run during defrost; replace timer.
cases.coverage_reason: WIC has defrost context, but timer NC-contact state is not yet a structured input.

cases.title: Gas furnace limit open with blower winding open
cases.expected_answer: Indoor blower motor failed; loss of airflow caused the limit switch to open.
cases.coverage_reason: Heating-mode furnace safety sequence is outside current WIC system model.

cases.title: Gas pack pilot works but no main heat
cases.expected_answer: Replace gas valve; main gas-valve coil is not operating despite 24 V.
cases.coverage_reason: Gas-valve/ignition system is outside current WIC system model.

cases.title: Heat-pump gauges show equal high/low pressures
cases.expected_answer: Gauge manifold valves are open, bleeding high side into low side; system itself is not faulty.
cases.coverage_reason: Requires service-manifold valve state / measurement-integrity evidence.

cases.title: Ice machine harvest has no air-assist output
cases.expected_answer: Replace control board; harvest outputs work except no voltage at air-compressor connector 25/26.
cases.coverage_reason: Ice-machine harvest sequence/control-board outputs are not yet modeled.

cases.title: Four-pin compressor will not start
cases.expected_answer: Internal compressor overload protector is open; normal winding resistances but C-T is open.
cases.coverage_reason: Reusable compressor protection/control evidence.

cases.title: Electric heat has insufficient capacity
cases.expected_answer: Replace heating elements HE1 and HE2; each has applied voltage but zero current.
cases.coverage_reason: Electric heat stages/elements are outside current WIC model.

cases.title: PTAC cooling capacity low
cases.expected_answer: Refrigeration system is partially restricted; low high/low pressures, partial frost pattern, slow pressure equalization.
cases.coverage_reason: Reusable refrigeration restriction pattern.

cases.title: Package heat pump totally dead
cases.expected_answer: Control-circuit fuse is blown; inspect control wiring/connections for a short before replacing fuse.
cases.coverage_reason: Reusable control-power/fuse troubleshooting.

cases.title: Gas furnace blower runs continuously
cases.expected_answer: Transformer failed: primary has 120 V and secondary has 0 V; loss of 2A coil power leaves NC relay contacts in blower-running condition.
cases.coverage_reason: Furnace transformer/time-delay relay sequence is outside current WIC model.

cases.title: Split A/C warm air; outdoor unit dead
cases.expected_answer: Contactor failed: 240 V line side + 24 V coil + 0 V load side.
cases.coverage_reason: Directly reusable contactor power-path logic.
cases.requiredHeadline: Contactor is energized but is not passing line voltage

cases.title: Heat pump lacks supplemental heat
cases.expected_answer: HC1 relay failed: 24 V at HC1 coil but 0 V at SH1.
cases.coverage_reason: Heating-stage relay/strip heat not in current WIC model.

cases.title: Package A/C compressor will not start
cases.expected_answer: Potential relay contact section failed open; start-capacitor circuit cannot be made, causing compressor failure to start and overload trip.
cases.coverage_reason: Potential relay contacts/start capacitor path are not yet structured inputs.

cases.title: Water in furnace after rain/snow melt
cases.expected_answer: Blocked downspout/underground drain backed water through the condensate pipe into the pan.
cases.coverage_reason: Building drainage/condensate backflow is outside current WIC diagnostic model.

cases.title: PTAC compressor starting problem
cases.expected_answer: Debris is a PTC soft-start device; it temporarily alters the start circuit/phase relationship to increase starting torque, then self-removes as resistance rises.
cases.coverage_reason: PTC/soft-start component state is not presently represented.

cases.title: Package A/C insufficient cooling and frosted suction
cases.expected_answer: Clean the indoor coil; airflow rises when the access panel bypasses the dirty coil.
cases.coverage_reason: Reusable evaporator/indoor-coil airflow diagnosis.

cases.title: Ice machine low production in cool ambient
cases.expected_answer: Head pressure control valve/headmaster is faulty; it fails to maintain proper head pressure as ambient falls.
cases.coverage_reason: Head-control logic exists conceptually, but ice-machine application and direct valve-fault evidence are not yet modeled as an executable service-call input.
